notes.title: 1.0.5.930 is OUT!! New Feature : EFFECT GROUPING!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/cf39476e16a2b23ea4dbb13d339b868a674d0892.png[/img]

With this version we've added new features to PixageFX that allow you to create even more complex effects.

You can now change the INPUT image of any effect. The workflow, which previously worked only in a top-down order, now allows you to select a different INPUT Source at any step.

We've also added a new effect to support this workflow: CLONE

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/ab06e5a779c678e3d2d74f2dde482e41efae374a.png[/img]

With Clone; you can blend an INPUT image with a different image at any step.

You can also group your effects with the new Grouping feature. You can change the order as a group.

We've added an automatic numbering to the EFFECT CAPTION if you add another one of the same effect you've added.

[b]Import from Clipboard : [/b]Imports picture you copied to the 'Windows clipboard' into PixageFX.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/d0d5bc4da81f8f98914ce5ceb876030486258101.png[/img]
New effect added : [b]Dithering & Halftoning[/b]

With this new effect, new dithering algorithms have been added that were not previously available in PixageFX.

Ordered dithering algorithms have been diversified and additionally
- Floyd Steinberg
- Stucky
- Sierra3, two rows of Sierra and Sierra lite
- Jujini
- Added Burkes algorithms.
We reconsidered the existing ordered dithering algorithms. We've added more options for Bayer and also added some halftoning patterns.

[i]Important note: Currently, Pixelate effects still contain old dithering methods. New dithering algorithms will be added to all pixelization effects when we are completely sure from user feedback and testing.[/i]

notes.title: Pixel Art Workshop is changing its name!!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/d2338d2978fc6d1c2980a093f2582e617cefd4ae.png[/img]

While Pixel Art Workshop initially focused only on pixelating images, now it has not only pixelation but also parametric tools that many other software do not have. That's why we changed the word Pixel Art to our new name, considering the feedback of some of our users and in order not to mislead new users. From now on, we will continue on our way with our new name but with the same thought. We hope you will continue your support and guide us.

notes.title: 1.0.5.6 is OUT! Faster AI and Better Debugging
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/f399417260068134dfbb2a3f78f000861e3fc8ae.png[/img]
We found a way to speed up some of our AI-enabled effects a bit more.
FindEdges->SForest method, AI Colorization effect, Pixelate Advanced AI object detection works much faster now. We've also made some additions to make it easier to debug the bugs that some of our users are experiencing after updates. Now, when there is a problem with the effects DLLs, the application will name the exact DLL file with the problem.

notes.title: 1.0.5.5 is OUT!! Meet Artificial Intelligence!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/b7cef595394741239610d225dc7f2fb57861c628.png[/img]
In this version, we added some features based on artificial intelligence.

[b]- AI Colorization : [/b]
This new effect can colorize black and white images with the help of artificial intelligence. It usually gives better results if there are clear objects that it can detect. (Such as sky, clouds, people, tree and grass...)

[b]- Pixelate Advanced AI : [/b]
We renamed Pixelate Advanced 2 to Pixel Advanced AI. Because we added two new features.
First, we have increased the edge detection algorithms that make the details stand out in the pixelization process. Thus, you will be able to choose the most suitable edge finding method according to the content of the image. Two of them (SForest and HNED) methods use AI technology.
In addition, in the AI object detect section, if there is an object in your image that the application can recognize, you can make it focus on these parts during the pixelization process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/5036efd4d99df6b397646a5f5ed2394bde78d002.png[/img]

[b]- Scatter[/b]

We brought new features in Scatter Generator. Now you will be able to use the ellipse, line or sprite you draw as a source, not just the selection area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/a7af352e056de5559a3414ecead73cd2e858f134.png[/img]

[b]- New effect : Auto crop ;[/b]
With the auto crop effect, Pixel Art Workshop automatically crops the transparent part of the image. You can find it in the 'Edit'category.

[b]- New effect: Flip;[/b]
Flips the image vertically or horizontally. You can find it in the 'Edit'category.

[b]Some improvements:[/b]

[b]Scatter : [/b]
Added new source options in scatter generator. You will be able to select ellipse, line or sprite as the source. We will create a video tutorial soon for more detailed explanation.

[b]Normal Map Generator :[/b]
While alpha mode was active in normal map generator, alpha channel was bypassed in Test mode. We fixed it now.

[b]- New effect added : Normal Map Generator [/b]

[i]Unlike normal map generators in the market, Pixel Art Workshop finds the contours of the image and creates a normal map according to the contours. Thus, you can get normal maps with much more organic and depth when desired.
It also has a separate normal map mode for images with alpha channels.[/i]

[b]- New effect added : Alpha Glow[/b]

[i]Creates a glow based on the alpha channel.[/i]

In this version some minor bugs have been fixed and also a new effect has been added.

FACE DEFORMER EFFECT

With the 'Face Deform' effect, Pixel Art Workshop can detect and deform human faces in photos, giving them a new unrealistic shape. Currently, it can detect only one frontal-view face in the image.
After detection, you can deform eyebrows, eyes, chin, face, nose and lips.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4.6 is out!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/5b4728561d9c53a85a627f55087cf3d7cf4f317c.png[/img]

In this version, we have made changes in two effects. 

* The [b]Crop effect[/b] which previously only worked on percentages, now works with both percent and pixel modes. In Pixel mode, you can write exactly the output size you want in pixels.

* We also improved the [b]Resize Canvas[/b] (formerly Extend Canvas) effect so that  you can exactly set the outputsize in pixels.

Two new effects ([b]Alpha Threshold[/b] and [b]Color Counter[/b]) and a new category ([b]Info[/b]) have been added.

* [b]Alpha Threshold:[/b] With this effect, you can set an alpha pixel to a fixed value to the lower and upper values of a certain threshold value. For example, you can clear (or set them to zero) all alpha pixels which have values below 255.

* [b]Color Counter:[/b] This is a new [b]'info category'[/b] effect that calculates exactly how many unique colors are in your pixel art image. Thus, you will be able to get the number of colors in the image at any stage you want.

notes.title: 1.0.4.4 RELEASE! New LOOKUPTABLE (LUT) Effect
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/d42d024fa3304aa2104991e14ec7e3640a37b0e8.png[/img]

With new LUT effect, you will now be able to use CUBE extension LookUpTable files.

Unfortunately there are some limitations on this effect.
* Cannot currently process CUBE files above LUT_3D_SIZE 33 (For example cannot process LUT_3D_SIZE 64)
* If there are some unclamped values in the CUBE file, undesirable results may occur.

However, we will improve this effect and remove limitations as well.

notes.title: 1.0.4.0 Released!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40136733/252bb7d4864d9e4b586efc8885ed53524c4a17a3.png[/img]

[i]We know we haven't been updating for a while. But with this new version, we fixed many bugs and added new features we think you will like.[/i]

[b]What's new and fixes in this major update?[/b]

[b]BETTER PERFORMANCE & LESS BUGS :[/b]

* First of all, Pixel Art Workshop was completely 64 bit. In this way, problems with system memory have been resolved.

* User interface and effect processing is faster.

* Many of the crash problems have been solved

[b]NEW FEATURES :[/b]

* VIDEO EXPORT : Now you can create mp4 files directly with Pixel Art Workshop!

* VIDEO IMPORT :  In the video import you can see the original FPS of the video.

* DRAG & DROP FILES : You can drag and drop PNG, JPG, GIF and MP4 files into Pixel Art Workshop.

* DRAG & DROP PROJECTS : You can drag and drop project files (.pawproject) extension into Pixel Art Workshop.

* EFFECT PARAMETER UNDO / REDO 

* BETTER 'ADD EFFECTS' WINDOW : You will now see predefined thumbnails showing what the effects do.

* FAVORITES for ADD EFFECTS & IMAGE LIBRARY WINDOWS : You can add the effects or library images you use frequently to your favorites.

* PREFERENCES - FPS SETTING : You can get a smoother interface by increasing the FPS value of the application. (May increase CPU and GPU usage). 

That's all for now. Please continue to share bugs you found and ideas with us.

notes.title: 1.0.322 Release
notes.notes:
What's new in this version;

The color limit for the 'Palette Quantization' effect has been increased to 256. 
Also, the 'Load Palette' part has changed a bit. 
Thus, you can now create palettes from any image within the color limit. This will allow you to use exported PNG palettes from different applications.
(Only PNG, JPG and GIF images are supported. Palette formats such as JASC PAL are not currently supported.)

notes.title: Pixel Art Workshop 1.0.2 Released
notes.notes:
Release notes:
Known bugs:
- Some video formats may experience skipping and freezing. This is a known bug and will be fixed in future versions.
- Inverted edge option in selection modes makes alpha completely black in transparent images.
- In some long-running processes (such as the Mean Shift effect) the program can go into an infinite loop. The only way to fix this right now is to delete that effect. It will be fixed as soon as possible.
- Remembering the last entered folders feature may not work in some cases.

Newly Added features:
- Pixelate Advanced 2: Helps you get more consistent results.
- Remove Antialias: Cleans antialiased pixels and gives more pixelart-like and sharp results.

Features to be added soon:
- Thresholding and smoothing will be added to Laplace and Highpass effects, thus making these effects more usable.
- Mp4 video export feature will be added.
- Layer feature will be added. Thus, it will be possible to work with more than one source image.
